context_requirements: Dopamine receptor expression (DRD1/DRD2) on the cell line; most of these lines are not dopaminergic and express little or no DRD1/DRD2
Intact Gs/Gi-coupled cAMP signaling and CREB activation
Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage for robust IEG induction; the nine lines are non-neuronal
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of FOS, EGR1, or JUN at 6 h in any of the nine lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 10 micromolar that are blocked by a DRD2 antagonist such as haloperidol
Consistent proliferation or apoptosis signatures at 24 h across multiple lines

evidence.supports: Full D1 agonist SKF-82958 induces c-fos and zif/268 in intact rat striatum, showing D1-mediated immediate early gene induction in dopaminoceptive neurons
D1 agonist induces preprodynorphin and substance P gene expression in striatonigral neurons, blocked by D1 and D2 antagonists
Repeated D1 agonist produces sustained ERK phosphorylation and CREB activation in cortex, linking D1 stimulation to transcriptional programs
D1 agonist regulates striatal neuropeptide gene expression via CREB, demonstrating D1-coupled transcriptional responses

changes: Removed MYC and CCND1 from proximal_up: these are generic proliferation genes, not proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist transcriptional targets.
Removed MYC and CCND1 from late_up: same reason; proliferation genes belong in generic_effects, not proximal/late target lists.
Removed CCNA2 and CCNB1 from late_down: generic cell-cycle genes cannot be justified as direct dopamine-receptor-agonist-repressed targets.
Removed CREB1 from proximal_up: CREB is activated post-translationally by phosphorylation, not induced as a proximal transcriptional target of D1/D2 agonism.
Removed HES1 from proximal_up and late_up: Notch effector, not a validated proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist target.
Removed ID2 from proximal_up and late_up: generic differentiation/proliferation gene without direct dopamine-receptor-agonist evidence.
Removed GADD45B from proximal_up and late_up: stress-response gene, not a specific proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist target.
Removed SOCS2 and TRIB1 from late_up: these were listed as down at 6 h and up at 24 h without evidence; direction reversal is not supported by the cited abstracts.
Removed DUSP22 from proximal_down and late_down: no cited evidence supports dopamine-receptor-agonist-mediated repression of DUSP22.
Removed RGS2 from proximal_down and late_down: RGS2 is typically induced by GPCR/cAMP signaling, so listing it as down contradicts the mechanism.
Removed TSC22D3 from proximal_down and late_down: glucocorticoid-responsive gene, not a validated proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist-repressed target.
Removed NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, and TNIP1 from proximal_down and late_down: NF-kB inhibitor repression is not supported by the cited dopamine-receptor-agonist abstracts.
Removed CDKN1A and CDKN1B from proximal_down and late_down: cell-cycle inhibitors are generic, not specific proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist targets.
Removed ATF1 from proximal_up and late_up: no cited evidence supports ATF1 as a proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist-induced gene.
Removed FOSL1 from proximal_up and late_up: no cited evidence supports FOSL1 induction by dopamine-receptor-agonists in these lines.
Removed DUSP4 and DUSP6 from proximal_up and late_up: no cited evidence supports these as proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist targets.
Removed IER3 and ZFP36 from proximal_up and late_up: no cited evidence supports these as proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist targets.
Removed JUN from proximal_up and late_up: c-Jun is not established as a proximal D1/D2 agonist-induced IEG in the cited abstracts (c-fos and zif/268 are).
Removed EGR1 from late_up: EGR1/zif268 is an immediate-early gene expected at 6 h, not a late 24 h target.

Removed FOS from proximal_up: the cited abstracts support c-fos induction in striatum, but the hypothesis's own context notes the nine lines are non-neuronal and lack DRD1/DRD2, so proximal FOS induction cannot be justified here.
Removed EGR1 from proximal_up: same reason as FOS; no dopaminoceptive lineage in the nine lines.
Removed JUN from proximal_up: same reason as FOS and EGR1.
Removed IER3, ZFP36, DUSP4, DUSP6, ATF1, CREB1, HES1, ID2, FOSL1, GADD45B from proximal_up: no cited evidence supports these as proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist targets in the tested lines.

Removed CDKN1A, CDKN1B, TSC22D3, NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, TNIP1, SOCS2, DUSP22, RGS2, TRIB1 from proximal_down: no cited evidence supports these as proximal dopamine-receptor-agonist-repressed targets.
Removed DUSP4, DUSP6, IER3, ZFP36, GADD45B, FOSL1, ID2, EGR1, JUN, ATF1, HES1, SOCS2, TRIB1 from late_up: no cited evidence supports these as late dopamine-receptor-agonist-induced targets.
Removed CDKN1A, CDKN1B, TSC22D3, NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, TNIP1, RGS2, DUSP22, CCNA2, CCNB1 from late_down: no cited evidence supports these as late dopamine-receptor-agonist-repressed targets.

Kept evidence PMIDs 8861055, 9152408, 15229233, and 16257473: their abstracts support D1/D2 agonist-induced IEG and neuropeptide gene expression in dopaminoceptive neurons, consistent with the mechanism class.
